name.zh: 随机地形下的路线判断

summary.zh: 每局都要重新判断怎么走，而不是背熟同一条最优路。
summary.en: Read a new route each run instead of memorizing one optimal path.

rules.zh: 关卡用随机组合改变通道、危险与奖励位置。玩家观察当前局部信息，判断绕路收益与生存风险；学习保留的是规则和危险识别，而非每个房间的固定答案。
rules.en: Procedural layouts vary passages, hazards and rewards. Read local information and weigh detours against survival; learned rules and hazard recognition persist even when room solutions do not.

loop.zh: 带着规则经验进入下一层
loop.en: Carry rule knowledge to the next level

decisions.zh: 已知出口近在眼前，是否为看得到的奖励多冒一次险？
decisions.en: An exit is close: is a visible reward worth one more risk?

decisions.zh: 地形可改造时，绕路与直接开路的成本需要重新比较。
decisions.en: When terrain is editable, detouring competes with making a direct route.

effect.zh: 保证出口连通能把难度集中在选择；不保证则容易产生无解感。
effect.en: Guaranteed connectivity focuses difficulty on choices; without it, runs may feel unsolvable.

effect.zh: 短视野强调探路，长视野更像整体路线优化。
effect.en: Short visibility emphasizes scouting; broad visibility emphasizes route optimization.

contrast.zh: 《洞穴探险2》强调读懂随机组合的陷阱与平台；《女巫》还允许材料反应持续改写原本的地形。
contrast.en: Spelunky 2 emphasizes reading recombined traps and platforms; Noita also lets material reactions continuously rewrite the generated terrain.

combination.zh: 设计提案：随机矿洞保留玩家上次留下的支撑柱，地形变化与持久建设共同决定下一次的安全通道。
combination.en: Design proposal: a procedural mine retains support pillars from prior visits, letting shifting terrain and persistent construction jointly shape future safe routes.

setup.zh: 这次出口在左下方，右侧奖励附近却出现了新的陷阱布局。
setup.en: This run’s exit is down-left, while a reward on the right has a new trap arrangement.

action.zh: 你先观察陷阱的触发方式，再决定绕过去拿奖励。
action.en: Inspect how the trap triggers before deciding whether to detour for the reward.

result.zh: 你没有依靠上局路线，而是用熟悉的规则判断这局风险。
result.en: You judge this run using learned rules instead of following the previous route.

next.zh: 带着消耗后的资源进入下一块区域，重新判断局部路线。
next.en: Enter the next area with your remaining resources and reassess the local route.

firstStep.zh: 先随机组合少量手工房间，并验证入口到出口始终可达。
firstStep.en: Randomly assemble a small set of authored rooms and verify that the exit stays reachable.

pitfall.zh: 无限随机容易产生无解或无趣布局；先保证可读的选择，再增加组合数量。
pitfall.en: Unrestricted randomness creates impossible or dull layouts; prioritize readable choices before variety.

test.zh: 多次游玩后，观察玩家是否说出通用判断规则，而非只记住固定走法。
test.en: Across runs, check whether players learn reusable rules rather than a fixed path.
